shots.p: wide shot of a silent desert valley at night under a vast starry sky, a faint warm glow of a lamp from a distant tent where recitation is heard, mysterious unseen listeners implied by swirling sand
wide shot of a clear dawn path leading straight across the desert toward the rising sun, guidance and right direction
low angle view of an infinite majestic night sky full of galaxies, conveying exalted greatness, no figure
wide shot of a swirling dark sandstorm at night, chaotic and misguided, a sense of foolish falsehood
wide shot of a quiet starry desert, wind moving over dunes as if whispering surprise, contemplative
medium shot of a frightened traveler at night in a lonely valley clutching an amulet and muttering for protection, shadows growing larger and more fearful around him
medium shot of disbelieving men in an ancient town shrugging at an old graveyard, sure there is no resurrection, dusk light
wide shot of the night sky filled with streaking shooting stars and meteors, vast and guarded, crisp cold air
close-up of a single bright meteor streaking down across the dark sky, flashing like a watchful flame
wide shot of a peaceful earth at night, villages with small lights under an uncertain sky, half in storm and half in clear moonlight
wide aerial view of many separate winding paths splitting across a valley in different directions, diverse ways
wide shot of a vast desert surrounded by endless horizons with no place to flee, small dust devil vanishing, sense of being held within power
close-up on the face of a believer listening to recitation at night, calm and secure, lantern light
wide shot of two groups on a split road at dawn: one walking toward a bright lit mosque, the other turning toward a dark ravine
wide shot of dry dead branches piled as fuel near a smoldering fire in a dark ravine, non-graphic warning
wide shot of abundant pure water gushing from springs into green fields and orchards, rain falling, prosperity
medium shot of a wealthy farmer surrounded by plenty, pausing to consider; beyond him a steep rugged uphill path shrouded in storm for those who turn away
wide shot of an empty clean mosque interior at dawn with soft light through arches, devoted only to worship
wide shot of dense crowds of dust and swirling sand pressing toward a lit tent at night, as if many unseen listeners gathered closely
medium shot from behind of a man in a white robe praying alone on a mat at dawn in the open desert, sincere and unaccompanied
wide shot of a lone man standing at a crossroads holding an open lantern, unable to force anyone down a path, only lighting the way
wide shot of a lone traveler's empty shelter in a vast desert with no refuge in any direction, sweeping wind
medium shot of a courier on a camel riding at dawn carrying a sealed message across the desert, faithful delivery
wide shot of a small band of believers standing firm while a large proud army appears weak and scattered by a storm
wide shot of a long winding road vanishing over the horizon, unknown distance, hourglass on a rock in foreground
wide shot of a sealed cave mouth under a starry night, mysteries hidden, deep silence
wide shot of a protected caravan path guarded by watchful sentinels' torches along cliff edges at night, no faces
wide shot of a starry sky with countless stars in precise order, sense that everything is counted and encompassed
